scripts.build: bun run clean && mkdir -p dist && bunx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js --log-level=info && bunx esbuild src/service-worker.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/service-worker.js --log-level=info && cp manifest.json dist/
scripts.build:watch: bun run clean && mkdir -p dist && bunx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js --watch=forever & bunx esbuild src/service-worker.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/service-worker.js --watch=forever & cp manifest.json dist/ && wait
